name: Guillermo Rodriguez
source:
Class: Warrior

Guillermo radiates intense, cold arrogance. His extreme level of wealth hardly makes him more approachable. 

He's forced to work with Julian in an online class, and acts like he hates him...until his icy exterior starts to melt into deeper feelings.

[From [url=https://gallium-games.itch.io/guilded-hearts]official page[/url]]

[spoiler]His in-game nickname is Kalanex.[/spoiler]
